root_cause: The executor checked only normalized results already persisted on disk. It had no exclusive batch lease and no durable call reservation before constructing a provider transport.
failure_sequence: Primary E004 invocation began and persisted normalized results incrementally.
Overlapping E004 invocation scanned the output root only once per call.
The overlapping invocation skipped two results that were already normalized but dispatched ten calls whose primary results had not yet persisted.
No atomic reservation or active-owner lock prevented either transport creation or provider dispatch.
